text: (d) 6 points Let T be the root node of a complete binary search tree. Recall that complete binary trees are such that every level is full except perhaps the last level, which is ‘filled-in’ from left to right. Let y be a reference to a node in the tree that is not in the last level. The goal is to return a reference to the node that would follow y in ‘level-order’ traversal. Your job is to write the pseudo- code for an algorithm called MyNeighbour(7',y) which returns a reference to the node which follows y in ‘level-order’ traversal. Y Retum You can assume that y is not in the last level, and then y is not the right-most node in its level. Justify the runtime of O(h).
